title.es: Camión de bomberos Spartan con escalera
title.pt: Caminhão de bombeiros Spartan com escada

generated.description: A fire truck with an aerial ladder, built mostly from quartz stairs, concrete, slabs, carpets and banners, with red and gray tones. It measures 19 blocks wide, 6 high and 6 deep, using about 344 blocks in total. The build includes hoppers, a dispenser, a shulker box, signs and banners as small details.
